description: Static reflow audit against WCAG 1.4.4 Resize Text, 1.4.10 Reflow, 1.4.12 Text Spacing, 1.3.4 Orientation and 1.4.13 Content on Hover or Focus. Pass `html` and/or `css`, or a public `url` (the page and up to 4 same-site stylesheets are fetched). Flags viewport meta that blocks zoom, fixed pixel widths and min-widths over 320px, overflow hidden with fixed heights, px base font sizes, vw font sizes without clamp, !important on line-height, letter-spacing or word-spacing, orientation locks, nowrap text, tables without a scroll wrapper, hover-only reveals, and pages with no width media queries. Each finding names the criterion and gives the fix. Reads source only: it does not lay the page out or run script, so confirm at 320px width and 400 percent zoom.

css.description: CSS text to analyze, with or without html.

html.description: Page HTML source. Optional if url is given.

url.description: A public page to fetch instead. Up to 4 same-site stylesheets are fetched too.

name: check_reflow
title: Reflow and resize check
